messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
Memory: one remembered fact per line, with the dates it held and the note that recorded it. An indented "earlier" line is a version of the fact above it that was later corrected.
- [constraint] Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request. (since 2025-04-02; source standup/ember/2025-04-02)
- [decision] The billing API gates the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. (since 2025-09-30; source standup/atlas/2025-09-30)
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. (since 2025-01-09; source standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2)
- [constraint] The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, the peak season. (since 2025-11-11; source standup/atlas/2025-11-11)
- [constraint] The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC. (since 2025-02-11; source standup/atlas/2025-02-11)
- As of 2025-12-01, the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump, per a heads-up from Boreal team. (since 2025-12-01; source standup/boreal/2025-12-01)
- [decision] As of 2026-01-12, the billing API is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then. (since 2026-01-12; source handover/2026-01-12-billing-api)
  - earlier: [decision] From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Atlas team. (held 2025-07-03 to 2026-01-12; source handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction)
  - earlier: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Boreal team. (held 2025-06-09 to 2025-07-03; source handover/2025-06-09-billing-api)
  - earlier: Since 2025-03-07, the billing API is owned by the Ember team. (held 2025-03-07 to 2025-06-09; source handover/2025-03-07-billing-api)
  - earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team. (held 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-07; source standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2)
- The Cinder team observed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the billing API's owners. (since 2026-03-11; source standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2)
- On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the billing API handover document for Lena. (since 2025-06-09; source handover/2025-06-09-billing-api)
- The billing service is not the Ember team's service, so the Ember team flagged the billing service's queue depth issue. (since 2025-11-04; source standup/ember/2025-11-04)
- The Ember team saw that the billing service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send. (since 2025-11-04; source standup/ember/2025-11-04)
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. (since 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-09-23)
- [decision] Ledger service migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan. (since 2025-05-30; source incident-review/INC-2025-011)
- From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team, not the Atlas team. (since 2025-10-13; source handover/2025-10-13-ledger)
- Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners. (since 2025-02-21; source standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2)
- [constraint] Per policy, every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. (since 2025-07-29; source standup/ember/2025-07-29)
- The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout. (since 2025-04-07; source standup/ember/2025-04-07)
- The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. (since 2025-02-21; source standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2)
- [constraint] Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. (since 2025-02-18; source standup/ember/2025-02-18)
- Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service. (since 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-09-23)
  - earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export. (held 2025-01-21 to 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-01-21)

Question: What does a change to billing-api need before it can merge?

message.content: A rollback plan attached to the pull request.
